pull_request.body:
Task request: https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/issues/131
Label request: `131-35766022791`

Addresses #131 at `3dab2346c4a08fd24898a7842906601884708a7d`. Ran 100 electrons without tracker, beam pipe or magnetic field, retaining the earlier pilot’s four directions and nominal pT = 50 GeV.

- Initialization to first event: **205.629 s**, including native audit and first-run physics setup.
- Event-loop average: **16.648 s/electron**.
- Total process wall: **31.65 min**.
- Output: **625.810 MB total; 6.258 MB/event**, compressed EDM4hep ROOT TTree files including truth, hits and file overhead.

| η | Events | s/electron | MB/event |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 0.50 | 25 | 4.741 | 1.692 |
| 1.45 | 25 | 7.664 | 3.271 |
| 2.00 | 25 | 15.801 | 5.680 |
| 3.00 | 25 | 38.385 | 14.389 |

Adds the report, compact results, reproduction scripts and input controls under `docs/validation/issue131/`, plus paired session records. Updates software inventories and project tracking, including verified PR129 merge metadata. DES-030/DES-031 approval states remain unchanged.

Validation passed: Release build, fresh export, DDSim execution, all 100 persisted-event audits, eight input/composition tests, tracking schema and summary arithmetic, software inventory, session records, 111 existing interaction ledgers, token validation/build and whitespace checks. Changed Spack fingerprints were reverified through actual runtime checks.

Historical evidence is now available. A fractional UTC collection timestamp was normalized; project validation passes. Timings describe one sandboxed run without load isolation.

Raw events and logs remain local and ignored. Ten proposed text files were inspected; the largest new file is 13,446 bytes. Exact closed-turn task counters have now been recovered; the full-chain accounting and daily work labels are retained by PR137. The numbered interaction record is retained.


## PR134 source retained in this PR

A publishing race briefly made PR134 head reachable from this base branch, and GitHub automatically marked PR134 merged into this branch at2026-11-12T16:54:27Z. No main merge occurred. Ordinary corrective commits retain the original history and this PR now includes the complete10k angular study and control plots. PR134 remains the historical discussion/source record. Merge this PR, then135,136,137 with ordinary merge commits, retargeting each remaining dependent PR to main after its predecessor. Do not squash/rebase frozen source history.

Follow-up to #133 and #131: generate and validate 10,000 single electrons with uniform total energy 10–80 GeV, eta −3 to 3 and full phi, using 12 DDSim/Geant4 workers on the unchanged ECAL-only zero-field prototype.

Adds reproducible HEPEvt generation, a native per-worker transport audit, ID-indexed readback, and ten-bin |eta| and signed sector-folded-phi plots. The observable is sample SD(R)/mean(R), R = raw silicon deposit / primary energy, with 5,000 joint whole-event bootstrap replicas and retained covariance. This is spectrum-averaged visible-response width, not calibrated intrinsic energy resolution. All 42 zero-response events remain included.

All 10,000 saved primaries and 6,289,322 cell hits pass readback. Serial and 12-thread controls agree exactly for 24 matched event summaries. Whole process: 585.694 s, 2.371 GiB peak RSS, 12.604 GB ROOT output. Disk checks retained all requested events and about 401 GiB free.

Validation: five mathematical controls; per-worker audits; complete input/readback/hash checks; finite intervals and positive-definite 20×20 covariance; independent PhysVal and SoftEng reviews; project records, software inventory, session/interaction/token validation and token-site build; whitespace and new-object inspection. No detector design or approval state changed.

Raw ROOT data, input/event ledgers, logs and builds remain local and ignored. The PR contains recipes, figures, compact binwise evidence and curated records. Exact task token counters are unavailable.

The `nodd-coordinate`, `nodd-review-validation` and `acts-spack` instructions
were read. PhysVal and SoftEng received explicit complete repository profile
instructions through generic subagents; native profile loading is not claimed.
Both worked read-only with no owned write files or nested delegation. Assignment
contracts were recorded in this journal before dispatch; earlier committed
versions retain the original detailed source/file/completion contracts.

- ECAL10K-PHYSVAL at 7ba71eee: prospective estimator, uncertainty/zero treatment
  and actual fold symmetry from DES-030/031, existing response protocols and
  replica/folding code. Returned the adopted R-width contract, bootstrap and
  signed-fold rules; no human approval was inferred.
- ECAL10K-SOFTENG at 7ba71eee: installed/pinned DD4hep input, locking, event
  seeding and worker audit/output route. Returned HEPEvt and worker-audit plan;
  no simulation was delegated. Its trailing-true CLI suggestion was corrected
  from actual parser evidence before the successful pilot.
- ECAL10K-REVIEW-PHYSVAL at 48d1b1b, remediation verified at a53895fa:
  reviewed protocol, angular_analyze.py and mathematical controls. Identified
  nullable mean-plot guards and audited-receipt binding; both were fixed.
  Five tests and a separate synthetic joint-bootstrap control passed.
- ECAL10K-REVIEW-SOFTENG at 48d1b1b: reviewed runner, steering, native audit,
  CMake and pilot records. Independently checked hashes, twelve worker totals,
  shuffled output identities and exact serial/MT summary equality. Identified
  fresh-input provenance and receipt binding; both resolved before production.
- ECAL10K-FINAL-PHYSVAL at d7cae986: independently recomputed all 20 point
  statistics/quantiles and assignments from the hash-bound event ledger;
  checked intervals/covariance, denominators, zeros and both committed figures.
  No actionable findings. Did not rerun Geant4 or all bootstrap replicas.
- ECAL10K-FINAL-SOFTENG at d7cae986: independently checked input/geometry/source/
  receipt/ledger bindings, all worker audits, all 10,000 ledger identities,
  bin moments, resource values and exclusion of raw data from new Git objects.
  No actionable findings. Did not repeat native ROOT readback or its 12.6-GB hash.

Child task addresses are `/root/ecal10k_physval` and `/root/ecal10k_softeng`;
these are exposed assignment addresses, not invented persistent client IDs.
All advice/reviews are agent technical assessments, not engineering sign-off.

events.text:
The [question on PR #133](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/133#issuecomment-6793261345) asks whether merging hits in the same readout cell could reduce output size.

**Cell-level merging already happens.** DD4hep sums deposited energy by cell ID, but still writes a separate truth contribution for every simulated step, including energy, time and particle association—even with detailed-shower mode disabled. See the [hit accumulation](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/blob/v01-38/DDG4/plugins/Geant4SDActions.cpp#L41) and [EDM4hep writer](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/blob/v01-38/DDG4/edm4hep/Geant4Output2EDM4hep.cpp#L683).

A compact output could aggregate those contributions by cell, particle and time bin, or retain cell energy with a defined timing summary. That trades away step-level detail. The next useful check is a compressed-size breakdown followed by a compact-output comparison; the saving is currently unmeasured.

[Investigation logged]([redacted] Journal and dashboard validation passed. Exact token counters were unavailable.

events.text: The recorded run used `ddsim --numberOfThreads 1`. DDSim 1.38 supports `--numberOfThreads N`; I’m checking whether the installed Geant4 build enables it. The Spack fingerprints still differ from the registry, so I’m verifying the installed files directly.
events.content_kind: visible_message; conservative redactions recorded in source

events.text:
Yes—the run used **DDSim 1.38**, driving Geant4 11.4.3, with `--numberOfThreads 1`.

**DDSim supports multithreading**, and I verified that the installed Geant4 build enables it. Select the worker count with `--numberOfThreads 4` or `-j 4`. [DDSim implementation](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/blob/v01-38/DDG4/python/DDSim/DD4hepSimulation.py#L576).

Threads simulate **different events concurrently**. Geometry and physics tables are shared; hit collections and event state are private to each worker. Consequently, RAM is not simply the thread count multiplied by the measured 1.88 GiB. [Geant4 threading model](https://geant4.web.cern.ch/documentation/pipelines/master/bftd_html/ForToolkitDeveloper/OOAnalysisDesign/Multithreading/mt.html).

Our exact benchmark steering, audit and output checks have only been validated with one thread. A short multithreaded test is needed before claiming its throughput or memory requirements.
